title: A share's revocation or deletion receipt, peer-share-revocation/1 and peer-share-deletion/1 (DEC-0142)
description: The sender's revocation of a share, signed by the sender's share #sig, which the mailbox holds and refuses every renewal and delivery after; and the recipient's receipt that it deleted the share's envelopes and lease, signed by the recipient's share #sig and naming the revocation by digest (peerRecordStands). Neither ends a copy: only the provider's revocation or rotation does. docs/specification/peer-share.md#taking-a-share-back.

signer.description: The RFC 7638 thumbprint of the signing share #sig.

sig.description: ES256 over the RFC 8785 bytes of the record without sig.

revocation.description: sha256: over the RFC 8785 bytes of the revocation it answers.
